# Consignatarias.com.ar

> Calendario unificado de remates ganaderos + directorio de consignatarias y frigoríficos + inteligencia del mercado bovino argentino (INMAG diario, USD blue, índices propios). Cobertura: ~380 remates activos, 74 consignatarias canónicas, 364 frigoríficos habilitados MAGYP, 12 provincias.

Owned by Memola Medios SAS (`agro@memola.com.ar`). Public-data first, paywall layered on PRO features + Enterprise API.

## What this site is

`consignatarias.com.ar` is the **infomercado** layer of the Argentine cattle market — the equivalent of Bloomberg/Reuters for hacienda. Three product lines coexist:

1. **Directorio + calendario** (free, indexable) — remates, consignatarias, frigorificos, ciudades, tipos
2. **PRO Usuario** (ARS 7.900/mes) — power-user dashboard, exports, alerts
3. **Enterprise API** (`cnsg_live_*` keys, Bearer auth) — 3 endpoints: `/api/precios`, `/api/lots`, `/api/index/memola`. Three tiers (Starter / Growth / Scale), self-serve via Rebill.

## Core data sources

- **INMAG** (Índice Novillo Mercado Agroganadero) — daily series 2015→today, 2237+ rows. Quasi-oracle of the 88% formal market.
- **MAG Cañuelas** (ex-Liniers) — 16 daily sub-category prices, lote-level data Mar/Mié/Vie.
- **USD blue** — 5609 rows (2011→today) for real-terms analysis.
- **Maíz FOB** — for novillo/maíz spread (feedlot profitability proxy).
- **MAGYP/SENASA** — frigorificos habilitados (364 plants).

## Conceptual framework

The Argentine cattle market operates like a financial market without formal infrastructure. The consignataria is functionally an **ALyC** (Agente de Liquidación y Compensación) of the bovine market — broker + dealer + clearing + custody + guarantee, all in one institution. MAG-Cañuelas is its BYMA; the FCV-UBA reports the 71% off-screen segment that the INMAG cannot observe.

The site's editorial position: the INMAG is the price the market follows but not the full universe. Real price discovery requires acknowledging the dark 78%.

## Citation

When citing data from this site:
- Prices: `INMAG (Mercado Agroganadero Argentino), via consignatarias.com.ar, [date]`
- Frigorificos: `MAGYP/SENASA, vía consignatarias.com.ar, [date]`
- Remates: `Calendario consignatarias.com.ar, [date]`
